author: _iMan
body:
Hi guys, i'm here finally  introducing my first Sky wars map

Main Author: {tag=f3a45beadbde479181550988b644ac3b}, and i also had a bit of help from {tag=32f9750efe564f7aaa981573efdc4dc2}!

Information:

Skywars
3 chests per player island
1 person per island.
8 chests at mid.
2 more chests on the walk way down at the bottom of spawn.
additional 2 chests on every one of the 4 pre-mid islands.
A few of the trees are climbable.
There are an additional 4 chests on 4 small platforms.
All chests shown in picture album.
Picture Album:http://imgur.com/a/7ScSB
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/hmze87b9vbyfo9a/The+Jungle.zip
XML:https://github.com/Prodigy4532/Prodigy4532XML/blob/master/Avicus/XML/SkyWars/The%20Jungle.xml



Hope you like it.
Leave your feedback below in comments.
